notes.title: Damn Sexy Moves Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/d261e08ea978fa02f4a49d54193ecccf2b4ffa1a.png[/img]
Hello Everyone!

Today we're bringing the new update to Love Vibe: Aria! We have upgraded the sex system, improved interactions, added lots of new sex poses, and more!

notes.title: Game doesn't work on PC screen? Here's how to run NON-VR version.
notes.content:
We've noticed that some people have problems with running Love Vibe: Aria Non-VR version. 
If you start the game and it looks like this and you can't click on anything, follow below steps:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/a821012a777bdaa0107b448eaeedc1eb35e6c115.png[/img]

[h2]How to play the game on the PC screen.[/h2]
[h3]1. Add [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091300/Love_Vibe_Aria__PC_Edition/]Love Vibe: Aria - PC Edition[/url][/b] free DLC to your Steam Library. (After purchasing Love Vibe: Aria)[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091300/Love_Vibe_Aria__PC_Edition/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/58162b984fff6e9685d0d7e1e26d2e6c527590f3.png[/img]

[h3]2. Open [b]Love Vibe: Aria[/b] page in your [b]Steam Library[/b] and click PLAY (Launch option window will appear).[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/a473aa971e3e8e0dec177101f5e7ccb96f271d10.png[/img]

[h3]3. Choose [b]Play Non-VR Version[/b] and click PLAY button.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/98b238d91c3597bbb8b105b7fa2772368f2aca02.png[/img]

[h1]The game should open in Non-VR mode now.[/h1]

if you still encounter any issue with starting the game, please let us know at contact@redvibestudio.com

notes.title: Sexy Overhaul!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/04efb23dc01c85fe8156789206f69d2c3e7db1ba.png[/img]
Hello!

[b]Sexy Overhaul[/b] update is finally here! Improved graphics, new scenes and more! Check out all the hot new stuff.

Changes:[list]
[*]Graphics overhaul:
- totally new skin technique that works better with light, giving a better sense of depth and precision
-Better shading on all scenes
-Intercloth shading for greater realism. Clothes are now casting shadows on the body. (In the VR version it needs to be turned on in the graphic settings)
-New post-processing system with better ambient shading

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/69adf83406f0d0d13227741bf50dc1360ee041ea.gif[/img]

[*]Upgraded Aria customization with lots of new stuff: 
    - lipsticks, 
    - eyes color, 
    - skin tones, 
    - makeup, 
    - hair color

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/7d64888a8bef4a92202267d07db2cfaed171225b.gif[/img]

[*]4 new sex scenes: beach, hotel room, night party room, only sex scene (performance)
[*]Wardrobe scene remake - new room

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/96b432a427ab842972ee4aa3d650518c88df2e0d.png[/img]

[*]Aria's room remake - improved visuals
[*]11 post-process presets changed with + and - keys, for greater customization of game vibe
[*]Screenshot Mode: F5 - make better screenshots without UI elements.
[*]Aria custom posing in the sex scenes (before starting sex): 
   - change pose (next-F7, previous-F6)
   - move (num2, num4, num6, num8),
   - rotation (num7, num9), 
   - up/down (num1, num3)
[*]Revamped UI menus
[*]New ambient sounds
[*]New more precise way of choosing things in wardrobe - pointing with right finger and clicking grip
[*]New graphic settings - resolution, ambient occlusion
[*]Mouth texture and shading improved
[*]Tutorials in VR except cutscene are now properly spawning in front of player
[*]Problem with the disappearing cursor in menus solved
[*]Many quality of life improvements
[/list]

[h3]We're also participating in the Steam Winter Sale and the game is [b]30% off[/b] now![/h3]

There's also a new trailer and screenshots on the store page, check them out!
